page: Vultr vbm-128c-2048gb-amd is a bare metal server belonging to the Bare Metal SSD family. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an AMD EPYC 7713 processor. This dedicated CPU configuration delivers 128 physical cores and 256 vCPUs operating at a base frequency of 2.0 GHz.

The server is equipped with 2048.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is provided by a 960 GB solid-state drive (SSD). This configuration does not include any graphics processing units (GPUs). It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

With a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8:1 and 256 dedicated vCPUs, this bare metal server offers high resource density for memory-intensive and parallel processing workloads. The physical isolation of bare metal hardware eliminates virtualization overhead, though the local SSD storage capacity is relatively modest at 960 GB compared to the massive memory allocation. This server is designed for large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, virtualization hosting, and heavy enterprise workloads requiring massive memory capacity and high core counts.
